g.text: Teaching GENCO where it fails, and to warn when the solver will

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'TeX Gyre Heros'; fill: #57564f

g.text: Fine-tuned on 6,737 solver-labelled contingencies, GENCO misses fewer decisions on cases it never saw, in all three

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'TeX Gyre Heros'; fill: #57564f

g.text: training runs, at a price on ordinary ones. A small head on its embeddings flags cases the solver will not resolve.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'TeX Gyre Heros'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8d8c86

g.text: Bars: the published run (seed 0); dots: seed 1 and the first run. a: 401 clustered, 153 held-out, 347 random cases. b: released test scenarios. c: 870 frozen-test cases.
